# @bloomneo/bloom v6.0.0-rc.0

Scaffolding CLI for full-stack apps combining `@bloomneo/appkit` (Express
backend) and `@bloomneo/uikit` (React frontend) with Feature-Based
Component Architecture (FBCA). Cross-surface: web, desktop (Electron),
mobile (Capacitor).

Bloomneo makes business apps safe, consistent and maintainable, however much
of the code AI writes: rules enforced by the compiler, the database and
`bloom check`; one way to do each thing; fixes delivered through packages, not
copied templates.

This file is the canonical machine-readable reference for the bloom CLI
(`bloom create`, `bloom check`, `bloom manifest`, `bloom upgrade`,
`bloom start`) and the route-contract API.
Agents working in a scaffolded project should read the project's own
`docs/appkit.md` + `docs/uikit.md` for library APIs.

appkit, uikit and bloom release together on one version; a new app pins all
three to `^6.0.0-alpha.0`.

---

## Route contracts (6.0)

```ts
import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineRoute, createClient } from '@bloomneo/bloom';

export const getInvoice = defineRoute({
  method: 'GET',                        // GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE
  path: '/api/invoices/:id',            // must start with /api; :params need a params schema
  params: z.object({ id: z.string() }), // params | query | body | response: any Standard Schema
  response: Invoice,
  auth: { roles: ['admin.tenant'] },    // REQUIRED: 'public' | 'user' | 'apiToken' | { roles: [...] }
  tenant: true,                         // default: true unless auth is 'public'
});

const api = createClient({ baseUrl, getToken, frontendKey });
const invoice = await api.call(getInvoice, { params: { id } });
```

Exports: `defineRoute`, `createClient`, `ApiError`, `validate`, `buildPath`,
`isContract`, `isTenantScoped`, contract types.

Serving a contract (appkit): `export default await contractRouter([route(getInvoice,
async ({ params, query, body, user }) => …)])` from `@bloomneo/appkit/server` in
`src/api/features/<name>/<name>.route.ts`. `route()` applies the auth decision,
the tenant context and validation (400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`); the handler returns
the body.

---

## Commands

### `bloom create <project-name> [template]`

Scaffolds a new project at `./<project-name>/` from a template.

```
bloom create my-app                    # Default: basicapp
bloom create my-app userapp            # Named template
bloom create . userapp                 # Scaffold into current dir
bloom create my-app userapp --skip-install   # Scaffold files only, no npm install
bloom create my-app userapp --verbose        # Debug logging
```

Refuses to overwrite an existing directory (except `.`). Exits 1 on
conflict.

### `bloom check [--json] [--strict] [--no-db] [--probe <url>] [--destructive]`

Run in an app root (reads the app's `.env` without overriding the shell).
Reports route files with no auth decision (`ROUTE_NO_AUTH_DECISION`),
contracts no `route()` serves (`CONTRACT_NOT_SERVED`), apps with no
contracts yet (`CONTRACTS_NONE`, info), tenant tables without row-level
security when `BLOOM_DB_TENANT=rls` (`RLS_TABLE_UNPROTECTED`, `RLS_CHILD_UNPROTECTED` (child tables reached by foreign key; exempt with `BLOOM_DB_RLS_EXEMPT`),
`RLS_NOT_CHECKED`), 6.x version drift (`VERSIONS_OUT_OF_STEP`) and a stale
manifest (`MANIFEST_STALE`, `MANIFEST_NOT_BUILT`). `--probe <url>` logs in as
the users in `BLOOM_CHECK_IDENTITIES` (JSON: `[{"label","email","password"}]`,
two users in different tenants) against the local running app and reports
any row one tenant can reach from another (`TENANT_CROSS_TENANT_READ`,
`TENANT_CROSS_TENANT_WRITE`; with `--destructive`, `TENANT_CROSS_TENANT_DELETE`);
`PROBE_INCONCLUSIVE` is a failure, not a pass; `PROBE_NOT_RUN` means appkit
isn't installed. Every finding has a code, a location, the rule and the fix
(severities and meanings: `AGENTS.md`, section `bloom check`). Exit 1 when
something must change; `--strict` fails on warnings too; `--no-db` skips the
database check; `--json` prints `{ ok, strict, findings, summary }`. A fresh scaffold
passes.

### `bloom manifest [--check]`

Writes `bloom.manifest.json` (contracts with auth, tenant scope and input/
response types; features; tenant-scoped Prisma models) and a generated API
section in the app's AGENTS.md (and llms.txt, if present) between
`bloom:manifest` markers; text outside them is kept. Deterministic output.
Contract files are loaded with the app's `tsx`. `bloom check` reports
`MANIFEST_STALE` when either no longer matches the code. `--check` writes
nothing and exits 1 when stale. New apps get it at `bloom create`.

### `bloom upgrade [--write] [--to <version>] [--json]`

Moves a Bloom 5 app to 6. Dry run unless `--write` (clean git tree; `--force`
overrides). `--to` picks the target version (default: this bloom's). Applies
version pins (+ `zod`, `tsx`, `@types/express`), the `server.ts` switch to
`createApiRouter` from `@bloomneo/appkit/server`, and a `bloom check`
workflow; lists everything else (`UPGRADE_*`: old router copies, casts,
skipped majors; `REMOVED_*`: removed appkit/uikit APIs and env vars) with
file, count and fix. Every code: `MIGRATION-6.md`, "What bloom upgrade
reports". Rerunning after `--write` plans no edits.

### GitHub Action

```yaml
- uses: actions/checkout@v4
- uses: bloomneo/bloom@v6
  with:
    strict: true        # inputs: strict, database, working-directory, install, node-version
```

Runs the app's own `bloom check --json`, fails the job when it fails, and
writes findings as PR annotations and a job summary (output: `report`). New
apps ship it as `.github/workflows/bloom-check.yml`.

### `bloom start`

Runs a scaffolded project's production server. Requires a prior
`npm run build` — exits 1 with an actionable message if dist/ is absent.

Equivalent to running `npm run start:api` inside the project.

### `bloom --help | -h | help`

Prints usage. Exits 0.

### `bloom --version | -v | version`

Prints the installed bloom version. Exits 0.

---

## Templates

Every preset is the `app` base plus layers (`auth`, `admin`, `desktop`,
`mobile`). Flags add layers to any preset: `bloom create x --auth --mobile`.

| Name | Layers | Surface | Data | First-run command |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `basicapp` | — | Web | — | `npm run dev` |
| `userapp` | auth | Web | Prisma (SQLite by default) | `npx prisma db push && npm run dev` |
| `adminapp` | auth, admin | Web + admin console | Prisma | `npx prisma db push && npm run db:seed && npm run dev` |
| `desktop-basicapp` | desktop | Electron wrapper | — | `npm run dev:desktop` |
| `desktop-userapp` | auth, desktop | Electron wrapper | Prisma | `npx prisma db push && npm run dev:desktop` |
| `mobile-basicapp` | mobile | Capacitor wrapper (iOS/Android) | — | `npm run mobile:add:ios` then `npm run mobile:ios` |

`--legacy` and the frozen pre-5.1 template directories were removed in 6.0
(`bloom create --legacy` exits 1). `npx @bloomneo/bloom@5 create` reproduces an
old tree exactly.

Databases: SQLite is the zero-setup default (`DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db`).
Production, and every multi-tenant app, uses Postgres with
`BLOOM_DB_TENANT=rls` — appkit scopes queries to the caller's tenant with
row-level security, and `bloom check` verifies the policies.

### Template picker

- **Plain fullstack web app** → `basicapp`
- **Fullstack + auth + users** → `userapp`
- **Admin console** (users, audit log, settings, dashboard) → `adminapp`
- **Desktop** → `desktop-basicapp` or `desktop-userapp` (Electron wraps the same web build and API)
- **iOS + Android** → `mobile-basicapp` (Capacitor wraps the same web build; the API must run on a server the phone can reach)

---

## What scaffold produces

Every template includes:

- `AGENTS.md` — project-level agent rules (placeholders replaced at
  scaffold + re-filled by postinstall)
- `package.json` — pins `@bloomneo/appkit`, `@bloomneo/uikit` and
  `@bloomneo/bloom` to one `^6.0.0-alpha.0`, plus `zod` and a `postinstall` hook
- `scripts/copy-agent-docs.js` — postinstall script that populates:
  - `docs/appkit.md`, `docs/appkit-agents.md`
  - `docs/uikit.md`, `docs/uikit-agents.md`
  - `.claude/skills/` (every appkit + uikit skill)
- `src/web/` with FBCA feature structure; `src/web/pages.ts` holds the page
  glob that `<PageRouter>` (`@bloomneo/uikit/router`) routes from
- `src/api/server.ts` mounting `createApiRouter` and `requestId()`
  (`@bloomneo/appkit/server`), with the frontend-key gate, `/health` and
  `POST /api/client-error`
- `src/contracts/welcome.contract.ts` — the starter's public welcome routes as
  contracts, served by `features/welcome/welcome.route.ts` and called from the
  home page through `src/web/shared/client.ts`
- auth layer: `/dashboard` is uikit's `AppShell` inside `AuthGuard`, with nav
  collected from `shared/nav.*.ts`
- `bloom.manifest.json` and the generated API section of `AGENTS.md`
  (written after install)
- `.github/workflows/bloom-check.yml` — `bloomneo/bloom@v6`, strict
- `.env` with `VITE_API_URL`, `BLOOM_SERVICE_NAME`, matching
  `BLOOM_FRONTEND_KEY`/`VITE_FRONTEND_KEY`, and each layer's variables
  (auth: `DATABASE_URL`, `BLOOM_AUTH_SECRET`; admin:
  `ADMIN_USER_ROLES`, `BLOOM_SECURITY_ENCRYPTION_KEY`)
- Language: TypeScript; bundler: Vite

---

## Flags

```
--verbose           Debug logging during scaffold (stdio: inherit for npm install)
--skip-install      Scaffold files only; skip npm install (CI / dry-run)
--no-install        Alias for --skip-install
--auth              Add the auth layer (users, login, Prisma)
--admin             Add the admin layer (implies --auth)
--desktop           Add the Electron wrapper
--mobile            Add the Capacitor wrapper
```

---

## Exit codes

```
0    Success (scaffold complete, help printed, version printed, start
     succeeded, check passed, manifest written or up to date, upgrade planned
     or applied)
1    Usage error (no command, unknown command, invalid template name,
     --legacy, directory conflict, missing build, npm install failure);
     bloom check found something that must change; bloom manifest --check
     found it stale; bloom upgrade --write on a dirty tree
```

---

## FBCA in scaffolded projects

Features live under `src/web/features/<name>/pages/`. Each `.tsx` file
becomes a route (`main` maps to `/`). Discovery is the glob in
`src/web/pages.ts` — no manual route registration. Dynamic segments use
`[param]`; catch-all uses `[...path]`; `_`-prefixed files and folders are not
routes.

Adding a new page = creating a file. Adding an API feature = creating
`src/api/features/<name>/<name>.route.ts` (a plain router with a guard or
`isPublic`, or a `contractRouter`). The app has no router of its own to edit.

---

## Migration

Current release: **6.0.0-rc.0** (pre-release of 6.0; stable is 5.3.3).

### 6.0.0 (alpha) The starter is built on the 6.0 framework pieces: the API
router is `createApiRouter` from `@bloomneo/appkit/server`, the page router is
`<PageRouter>` from `@bloomneo/uikit/router` (the app keeps the glob in
`src/web/pages.ts`), the dashboard shell is uikit's `AppShell`, and the welcome
routes are contracts (`src/contracts/welcome.contract.ts`) called through a
typed client. Apps depend on `@bloomneo/bloom` and `zod`; bcrypt,
jsonwebtoken, helmet and morgan are no longer declared. New commands:
`bloom check`, `bloom manifest`, `bloom upgrade`, and the `bloomneo/bloom@v6`
GitHub Action. The admin layer stores email settings in the database
(encrypted), not `.env`. The frozen legacy templates and `--legacy` are gone.
See `MIGRATION-6.md`.

### 5.3.3 Apps created by 5.3.2 did not compile: the `/api`
404 handler in `server.ts` was never closed. 5.3.3 closes it, and every preset
is now installed, typechecked and booted (development and production) in CI.
Also: `.env` now carries `BLOOM_SERVICE_NAME` (production refused to start
without it) and matching `BLOOM_FRONTEND_KEY` / `VITE_FRONTEND_KEY` values,
the web client sends `X-Frontend-Key`, login tokens carry `tenantId`, secrets
come from `crypto`, and the admin layer writes `ADMIN_USER_ROLES` (the name
its code reads) instead of the unread `BLOOM_ADMIN_ROLES`.

### 5.3.2 An unmatched `/api/*` path now returns a JSON 404
instead of the single-page app.

The SPA fallback is a catch-all and its comment claimed it served index.html
"for all non-API routes", but nothing excluded /api — so a path matching no
route fell through and answered 200 with a full HTML page. That is the exact
failure `shared/api.ts` grew a content-type check to survive: ask for JSON, get
a webpage, and report a parse error nowhere near the mistyped path.

### 5.3.1 Scaffolded apps now ship a `.gitignore`.

The `app` base did not have one — only the deprecated frozen templates did — so
every app composed since 5.1 was created without it. The first `git init && git
add .` in a new project therefore committed `node_modules` and the `.env` that
`bloom create` had just generated real secrets into: BLOOM_AUTH_SECRET, which
signs every JWT the app issues, and BLOOM_FRONTEND_KEY, which gates the API.

The file is `.gitignore.template`, because npm strips a bare `.gitignore` from a
published tarball. It deliberately does NOT ignore `public/` (the favicon and
self-hosted fonts live there — a bare `public` line inherited from Gatsby
boilerplate would drop them silently) or `prisma/migrations/`.

### 5.3.0

Closes the last blind spot in the log: a browser
crash now reaches the server.

`PageRouter` has always accepted an `onError` callback and no template ever
passed one, so a React render crash called nothing — the only other trace was a
`console.error` behind a dev-only guard. In production a page could throw, blank
out, and leave no record anywhere. That was the one failure the log could not
see, and the one a user actually notices.

The base now ships `POST /api/client-error`, and the browser reports to it from
three places: the render boundary, `window.onerror`, and unhandled promise
rejections. Reports are logged in the same format, through the same logger, and
carry the id of the last API call the page made — so a crash and the request
that caused it are one story. Reports are deduplicated per page load and capped,
because a render loop throws the same error hundreds of times a second.

For a render crash the log names the file and line:

    client render: Cannot read properties of undefined page=/customers req=30ffe450
      at CustomerDetail (/features/customers/pages/[id].tsx:88:14)

### 5.2.6

Made the log readable: one line per request,
carrying method, path, status, duration and a correlation id, logged on
completion so it can report an outcome. Narration of steps that succeeded is
gone, along with a probe that reported three database failures at every healthy
boot. Requires `@bloomneo/appkit` >= 5.1.2, which renders log metadata inline
instead of dropping it.

### 5.2.5

Made the logs usable: structured fields are no
longer discarded by default, every request carries a correlation id, and a
per-request warning that named the wrong environment now fires once at boot.

Structured fields were being dropped because AppKit's logger defaults to
`minimal` scope, which prints the message and discards the metadata object —
so `logger.info('Incoming request', { method, url })` rendered as the bare
words. `BLOOM_LOGGER_SCOPE=full` now ships in the generated `.env`, documented
in place. Every request also carries an `x-request-id`, echoed to the response
and attached to its log line; `shared/api.ts` puts it on the thrown `ApiError`,
so a browser-side failure names the server log line to grep for.

### 5.2.4

Fixed a dev-server bug where a newly created page file did not become a route
until the server was restarted.

Page discovery is `import.meta.glob`, which Vite resolves once, when it
transforms `page-router.tsx`. Create `features/billing/pages/plan.tsx` while the
dev server is running and the glob is never re-evaluated — the route does not
exist. The symptom is a silent 404, and if a sibling dynamic route is present it
is worse: a new `pages/new.tsx` is swallowed by `pages/[id].tsx`, so the app
reports "invalid id" for a file sitting correctly on disk. Nothing in that points
at the dev server.

The template now ships a `bloom:page-router-hmr` Vite plugin that watches the
page directories and invalidates the router when the set of page files changes.
Adding a page is a file again, with no restart.

### 5.2.3

Fixed a two-release-old bug where the project's own `.env` was never read by the
web build.

Vite's `envDir` defaults to `root`, and the template sets `root: 'src/web'` — so
Vite looked for `src/web/.env`, never found one, and every `VITE_*` variable
silently fell back to whatever default the code supplied. `VITE_API_URL`, added
in 5.2 specifically to remove that guess, had never once been loaded.

It hid because the fallback (`http://localhost:3000`) happened to match where the
API runs by default. It only surfaced on a real project whose API was on another
port — and when it did, it surfaced as exactly the error 5.2 added for it:

    Expected JSON from http://localhost:3000/api/customers but got HTML.
    The API base URL is probably wrong … Set VITE_API_URL in .env.

The loud failure worked. The setting it pointed at did not. `envDir: __dirname`
is the fix; verified by building with VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:9999 and
confirming the value is inlined.

Prior release: **5.2.2**. Stops the API router discarding the reason a feature
failed to load. A route file that threw during import was reported as
"Could not load route for feature X" — flattening a missing file and a broken
one into the same sentence, and throwing away the useful part. AppKit's guards
validate their arguments and report precisely; that message was being swallowed.

Now the two cases are distinguished and the underlying error survives:

    ⚠️  /api/badrole failed to load — the feature is NOT mounted.
        [@bloomneo/appkit/auth] Invalid role.level for middleware: "administrator". See: …
        in badrole/badrole.route.ts

    ⚠️  features/nofile/ has no nofile.route.ts — nothing was mounted.
        Discovery looks for that exact filename.

Prior release: **5.2.1**. Closes the last silent failure in a scaffolded app.
A feature router written without an auth guard used to start cleanly, mount with
a normal log line, and serve whatever it queried to anyone — nothing in
typecheck, build or boot objected. The API router now reads each route file at
discovery and warns, naming the file and both fixes:

    ⚠️  /api/leaky has NO auth guard — every route in it is public.
        Add `router.use(auth.requireLoginToken())` near the top of leaky.route.ts,
        or declare it deliberately public with `export const isPublic = true`.

Detection reads the SOURCE rather than the mounted router, because appkit's
guards are anonymous closures indistinguishable at runtime from any other
middleware — a router carrying only a logger would look guarded.

`export const isPublic = true` is the opt-out, and welcome, auth and
contact-message now declare it: a check that cannot be opted out of is one that
gets commented out wholesale.

Prior release: **5.2.0**. Closes the class of mistake that cost the most time
building with 5.1 — a plausible, wrong STRING that compiles cleanly and fails at
runtime with an error pointing nowhere near the cause.

`scripts/gen-api-routes.mjs` derives an `ApiRoute` union from the route files
(FBCA makes the mapping derivable: `features/<n>/<n>.route.ts` mounts at
`/api/<n>`). It regenerates on install, dev, build and typecheck, so it cannot
drift. `shared/api.ts` is the one authenticated client — it takes an `ApiRoute`,
owns the base URL and the JWT, and detects the HTML-instead-of-JSON response a
wrong base URL produces, replacing "Unexpected token '<'" with a message naming
the cause. `VITE_API_URL` now ships in every generated `.env`.

Two silent failures made loud: the API router warns when a `.route.ts` it will
never mount sits in a feature folder, and the admin layer's `adminFetch` is now
a thin deprecated shim over the shared client rather than a second
implementation that had already drifted.

AGENTS.md is rewritten as rules rather than reference, and points agents at the
`.d.ts` (UIKit's complete public API is ~1.3k tokens) before the prose docs
(~23k tokens). Every rule in it maps to a mistake that actually happened.

Prior release: **4.2.4**. Docs-only patch: README gains an `adminapp`
Quick Start example and documents the `ADMIN_USER_ROLES`,
`ADMIN_ENABLE_AUDIT_LOG`, and `ADMIN_DASHBOARD_WIDGETS` env vars in the
Configuration section.

Prior release: **4.2.3**. Bumps the `@bloomneo/uikit` pin across all
templates from `^2.1.3` to `^2.1.5`. uikit 2.1.5 is a cosmetic cleanup
release that drops lingering `@voilajsx/uikit` references from its
user-facing docs (README, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md) — scaffolded apps no
longer inherit the voilajsx warnings through the postinstall hook.

Prior release: **4.2.2**. Dropped historical `@voilajsx/helix`
references (README, package.json description, llms.txt — changelog
history kept). Cleaned up `(err: any)` in the inherited userapp user
admin routes via a `normalizeError()` helper so strict TS catches
regressions.

Prior release: **4.2.1**. Security hardening pass on adminapp —
login now gates on `isVerified`, admin mutations are rate-limited
(60/5min), auth routes log through appkit/logger (not console.error),
error handling in auth routes is typed (`unknown` not `any`), and
`docs/admin-patterns.md` gains a security-posture section.

Prior release: **4.2.0**. Polished the `adminapp` template: three-
tier role model (admin/moderator/user), live `/contact` wiring,
signup gate, last-admin protection, consolidated settings UI, perf
sweep on admin pages, + `docs/admin-patterns.md` reference doc.

Prior release: **4.1.0**. Added the `adminapp` template + a
system-wide cuid primary key for User + folded the pending 4.0.1 bug
fixes (copy-agent-docs JSDoc fix, api-router structured errors,
VOILA_→BLOOM_ env migration, prisma version alignment) into one
release. Templates repinned to `@bloomneo/uikit@^2.1.3` for the
mobile sidebar → bottom-nav behavior. Jumping from any pre-4 version
needs the breaking ecosystem-pin bumps below. Existing scaffolded
projects keep working against their pinned versions — nothing
auto-upgrades.

### From `@bloomneo/bloom@1.5.x` / 2.x / 3.x → `4.0.0`

1. Re-scaffold (preferred — `bloom create` on a fresh project) or apply
   manual changes:
   - `@bloomneo/appkit` pin: `^1.5.1` / `^2.0.0` → `^4.0.0`
   - `@bloomneo/uikit` pin: `^1.5.1` → `^2.0.1`
2. Source changes for the appkit 2.0 rename:
   - `auth.user(req)` → `auth.getUser(req)`
   - `auth.can(user, perm)` → `auth.hasPermission(user, perm)` (if you
     used it — templates didn't)
   - `security.csrf()` → `security.forms()` (if you used it)
   - `handleErrors({ includeStack })` → `handleErrors({ showStack })`
3. Source changes for the uikit 2.0 rename:
   - `<Combobox onChange={fn}>` → `<Combobox onValueChange={fn}>` (if
     you used it — templates didn't)
4. Re-run `npm install` — the 3.x postinstall copies appkit's and
   uikit's `AGENTS.md` + `llms.txt` + skill trees into the scaffolded
   `docs/` and `.claude/skills/`.

### Why three majors in one day

`bloom@2.0.0` bumped the appkit pin (`^1.5.1` / `^2.0.0` → `^4.0.0`) because
appkit 2.0 was on npm `latest` and templates needed the modern API.
`bloom@3.0.0` bumped the uikit pin (`^1.5.1` → `^2.0.1`) because
uikit 2.0.1 also reached npm `latest`. Both peer-dependency major
bumps are breaking per semver, so each gets its own major.

### What 1.6.0 through 3.0.0 added (cumulative, since they were all
### unpublished until 3.0.1 on npm, then 3.0.2 for doc alignment)

- Root `AGENTS.md` (this doc's sibling) + `llms.txt` (this file)
- `scripts/check-doc-drift.mjs` + `scripts/scaffold-smoke.test.mjs`
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (Node 18/20/22 matrix)
- `--help` / `-h` / `help`, `--version` / `-v` / `version`,
  `--skip-install` flags on the CLI
- Unified `scripts/copy-agent-docs.js` across all 5 templates:
  copies appkit + uikit `llms.txt`, `AGENTS.md`, and skill trees into
  the scaffolded project's `docs/` and `.claude/skills/`; fills
  `{{PROJECT_NAME}}` placeholders; survives gracefully when a package
  (e.g. appkit for the mobile template) isn't installed.
- Templates use `"name": "{{PROJECT_NAME}}"` (was hard-coded
  `bloom-<template>`), so scaffolded projects get the user's actual
  name.
- Deleted stale `docs/UIKIT_*.md` template docs (deep imports +
  hallucinated `ValidatedInput` + nonexistent "UIKit CLI").
- Dead code removed from `bin/bloom.js`.
- Deleted 274MB `docs/` nested vite subproject (not shipped, no
  references).
- Fixed hallucinated doc refs in CLI output (`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`,
  `docs/MOBILE_DEVELOPMENT.md`) — those files never existed.

### Not ready yet (ecosystem state, 2026-04-17)

- `@bloomneo/appkit@4.0.0` exists on appkit's main branch but is NOT
  on npm. npm `latest` is 2.0.0. Bloom's `^2.0.0` pin correctly
  targets what's available.
- When appkit 4.0.0 publishes, bloom will cut another major that
  bumps the pin to `^4.0.0` + rewrites any template code using APIs
  renamed between 2.0 and 4.0 (principally the teardown verb
  unification: `shutdown` / class-level `clear` → `disconnectAll`).
  Templates don't currently call teardown methods so that bump is
  expected to be low-churn.
